name: Isosurface Extraction via Ray Marching
aliases: First-hit ray casting with isosurface thresholding
definition: A technique to render isosurfaces within a volume by detecting when the ray crosses the isovalue threshold during ray marching, then refining the intersection point and computing the normal.
summary: Isosurface extraction via ray marching renders scalar field boundaries by detecting threshold crossings during ray traversal, distinguishing itself from meshing methods by computing geometry per-pixel for interactive updates.
